run_otbench_prepare: run the otbench prepare command to prepare dataset files for benchmarking
run_otbench_generate: run the otbench generate command with a model to generate benchmark outputs
run_otbench_eval: run the otbench eval command to evaluate model outputs against the benchmark
run_otbench_full_pipeline: run the otbench run command to execute prepare, generate, and eval in sequence
create_otbench_overthink_dataset: run the otbench create_overthink command to generate an overthink dataset for a model
